posts.text: The Supreme Court issued an emergency order blocking a band by the fifth circuit court of appeals on mail order shipments of a specific medication.  The Supreme Court order is only temporary and will last for a week, during which time both parties will have to submit more information.

President Trump brags about handling math in cognitive test.  During a speech, Donald Trump told his audience the story of a cognitive test that he was administered that contained very difficult math problems, which he alone apparently aced.  this is the same president Trump, who said that he lowered prices by 600%.

President Tump announced that his face will be featured in thousands of newly issued U.S. passports, in a move that is unprecedented.  But people like @themeghanelinor argue that US presidents already appear on paper currency.  There’s only one small difference: they were all out there by someone else decades later.

Did Senator Elizabeth Warren, cause spirit airlines to go out of business? Many people, including Cathytalk are saying that it is because of Elizabeth Warren that spirit Airlines could not merge with JetBlue and was forced to go out of business on May 2, 2026. But that’s not how mergers work under United States Federal law.  It was a judge who rejected the merger

During an official state visit by the British Royal family, the Trump administration organized a ceremony where the Bristish flag, the Union Jack, was presented up upside down. This is not the only breach of protocol by the Trump administration during the royal visit, but it is another indication of the chaos that exists in the administration.

Is the war in Iran over? President Trump says so: he sent a letter to Congress saying that the hostilities in Iran have terminated just as the war power resolution 60 day clock reached the end.  that would’ve required congressional authorization for the hostilities to continue, but Trump apparently avoided it by calling the war finished.  ##iranwar

During a confirmation hearing, Trump’s nominees for judicial roles were unable to answer the same question given to each of them by Sen. Blumenthal.  The reaction suggested that these nominees are afraid of upsetting President Trump with their answer.

Erika Kirk was a guest at a podcast right after the White House Correspondents Dinner incident, and was able to talk about the effects that dehumanizing others has on those people and her husband.  She was so close, but missed the point.

Secretary of defense, Pete Hegseth testified before Congress about the Iran war. While trying to convince Congress that the war must continue indefinitely, and that the military needs more money, Pete Hegseth used the worst example of three wars: Iraq, Afghanistan, and Vietnam. Three of the longest, most expensive and least successful wars fought by the United States. Is this the best example he could find?

When people say “no due process coming in, no due process going out” about undocumented migrants, they show a misunderstanding of how the constitution works.  Being in the United States unlawfully has nothing to do with due process, but defending yourself against a government accusation has everything to do with it.  Let’s fact check @Sarah Sizzle and her claim about immigration.
